summary: Kimi Antonelli won the British Grand Prix Sprint from P2 on the grid, 2.7s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Alexander Albon made the biggest climb, from P22 to P18.
Sergio Perez had a day to forget, dropping from P18 to P22.
The stewards penalised PER (10 second time penalty).
There were 2 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 0 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 43 points over George Russell.
